intro: {{nameA}} in {{cityA}} and {{nameB}} in {{cityB}} both offer {{course}} programmes, but the subjects on this page are not identical. We compare recorded fees and admission routes from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
JIIT Noida vs Noida International University should be read with the table names, not the short title on this page. We do not have a 2020 or later MSc placement row for either side.

sections.heading: JIIT Noida vs Noida International University for MSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose JIIT Noida if you want a narrower MSc offering at a well-known Noida technical university, and you will apply through the current CUET PG process listed on our records.

Choose Noida International University if you want a named MSc in subjects such as computer science, chemistry, mathematics, physics, biotechnology, microbiology or agriculture, at a lower recorded year fee.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For JIIT Noida the page may add two Total Fees year rows of ₹87,100 and ₹91,500, which comes to ₹1.78 lakh. There is also a ₹500 application fee; that is not the MSc tuition and should not be read as the cheapest option.
For Noida International University we hold ₹77,000 as a Total Fees year figure across the listed MSc subjects. That is a year amount, not a confirmed two-year total.
We did not attach a new official programme total in this pass. Confirm the current MSc fee PDF on jiit.ac.in and niu.edu.in before you budget for two years.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither college has an MSc placement record for 2020 or later in our table, so this page cannot compare average or highest packages for the master's programmes listed here.
If placements are central to your decision, ask both career offices for a recent MSc-specific report. Do not borrow undergraduate engineering packages and treat them as MSc outcomes.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: JIIT Noida is listed with CUET PG. Noida International University has no exam mapped on this page, so follow its official admissions note for tests, merit lists and eligibility.
JIIT's listed programme is a generic Master of Science row, while NIU names several science subjects. Confirm the exact MSc specialisation on the official form before you apply.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: JIIT is in Noida and Noida International University is in Greater Noida, so the daily commute is not identical even though both are in the same NCR belt of Uttar Pradesh.
Visit both campuses if you can. One is a long-running technical university; the other is a private university with a wider subject list on this page.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick JIIT Noida if the institute brand and the CUET PG route matter more, and you have confirmed which MSc subject is actually open this year.
Pick Noida International University if you want a named science MSc at the lower recorded year fee of ₹77,000, and you accept that we have no recent placement row.
Location is a real difference here: Noida versus Greater Noida. Factor travel before you treat the fee gap as the only decision.

faqs.question: Is JIIT Noida's MSc fee only ₹500?
faqs.answer: No. The ₹500 row is an application fee. Our table also has Total Fees year figures of ₹87,100 and ₹91,500, which this page may add to ₹1.78 lakh. Confirm the official two-year total on jiit.ac.in.

faqs.question: What MSc fee is on record for Noida International University?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹77,000 as a Total Fees year figure for the listed MSc subjects, including computer science, chemistry, mathematics, physics, biotechnology, microbiology and agriculture. That is not a confirmed two-year total.

faqs.question: Do both colleges offer the same MSc subjects?
faqs.answer: Not on this page. JIIT has a generic Master of Science row. Noida International University names several science subjects. Check the official programme list before you assume a match.

faqs.question: Are MSc placements available for comparison?
faqs.answer: No. We do not have a 2020 or later MSc placement row for either college. Ask the placement cells for a recent, programme-specific report if outcomes matter to you.

faqs.question: Which exams do these MSc programmes accept?
faqs.answer: JIIT Noida is listed with CUET PG. Noida International University has no exam mapped here, so use its official admissions page for the current process.

faqs.question: Are the campuses in the same city?
faqs.answer: JIIT is recorded in Noida and Noida International University in Greater Noida. Both are in Uttar Pradesh's NCR belt, but the daily commute can differ.
